astranl.do_not_use_when: you need a quote, an individual permit or a person
astranl.next_possible_action: cite the provenance; the same fact is at https://astranl.com/api/construction
astranl.proof_level: as published by RVO / PDOK; bbox only, not a legal assessment
astranl.returns: sites with protection, status, bbox; provenance with licence and recount
astranl.use_when: you check whether a project area is near a Natura 2000 site (nitrogen permitting)

description: Natura 2000 sites in the Netherlands from RVO / PDOK: number, site label, protection type, status, site code, bounding box (lon/lat). Filter with site. Source recount is reported. Read-only aggregates: no permit rows, publication identifiers, titles, addresses, points or names; permit counts below 5 per authority per kind are shown as <5 and totals that would reveal one are lower bounds (>=n). Every answer carries source provenance (source, source_url, licence, as_of/retrieved_at, method, status) and an exposure block.

site.description: case-insensitive filter on the site label
